theme: 电影 · 超级英雄电影宇宙
goals: 学习超级英雄电影相关的核心词汇和表达
了解漫威电影宇宙的发展历程和特点
掌握描述电影情节和人物性格的实用表达
能够用英语讨论超级英雄电影的文化影响

tasks.text: 观看第一个视频，学习超级英雄电影发展史（5分钟）
阅读文章1-3，了解漫威宇宙起源（10分钟）
学习词汇表中的核心词汇（15分钟）
阅读文章4-7，学习电影角色描述（10分钟）
观看视频2-3，学习电影幕后故事（8分钟）
学习必学内容中的高频表达（7分钟）
阅读文章8-10，完成拓展内容学习（5分钟）

mustLearn.title: 高频表达：描述电影影响力
mustLearn.content:
English: "The Marvel Cinematic Universe has completely transformed the film industry, creating a new model for interconnected storytelling that audiences love."

中文讲解：这句话展示了如何用英语描述超级英雄电影对行业的影响。

要点解析：1. transform 改变、转型 2. interconnected storytelling 相互关联的叙事方式 3. model 模式、典范

mustLearn.title: 语法点：现在完成进行时
mustLearn.content:
English: "Superhero movies have been dominating the box office for over a decade, with Marvel leading the charge."

中文讲解：现在完成进行时表示从过去开始持续到现在的动作，强调动作的持续性。

要点解析：1. have been + doing 表示持续动作 2. for + 时间段 表示持续时间 3. dominate 占主导地位

mustLearn.title: 精读片段：超级英雄的魅力
mustLearn.content:
English: "What makes superheroes so appealing is not just their extraordinary powers, but their relatable struggles and growth. We see ourselves in their journey from ordinary to extraordinary, facing challenges that mirror our own daily battles."

中文讲解：这段文字揭示了超级英雄电影受欢迎的深层原因。

要点解析：1. appealing 有吸引力的 2. relatable struggles 能引起共鸣的挣扎 3. mirror our own 反映我们自身的

expand.title: 文化注释：超级英雄与美国文化
expand.content: 超级英雄电影反映了美国文化中的个人主义价值观。这些故事强调个人责任、正义感和为他人牺牲的精神，这与美国建国理念中的'美国梦'和'自由'精神相呼应。

expand.title: 同义替换：描述精彩的电影
expand.content: 精彩的电影可以用不同表达：1. mind-blowing (令人震惊的) 2. edge-of-your-seat (紧张的) 3. visually stunning (视觉震撼的) 4. emotionally gripping (情感扣人心弦的)

expand.title: 进阶例句：电影产业术语
expand.content: 1. The franchise has grossed over $22 billion worldwide. (这个系列全球票房超过220亿美元) 2. Sequels and prequels keep fans engaged in the universe. (续集和前传让粉丝对这个世界保持关注) 3. Cross-overs create epic cinematic moments. (跨界合作创造了史诗级的电影时刻)

expand.title: 背景知识：漫威 vs DC
expand.content: 漫威(Marvel)和DC是两大超级英雄电影宇宙。漫威以 interconnected universe(互联宇宙)概念著称，角色之间有关联；DC则更注重独立英雄故事，风格更黑暗严肃。

articles.title: The Birth of the MCU
articles.content: The Marvel Cinematic Universe began in 2008 with Iron Man. This movie started everything. Robert Downey Jr. played Tony Stark, a rich inventor who became Iron Man. The film was a big success. It showed that superhero movies could be both exciting and funny. This success led to more movies. Each movie connected to others, creating one big story. This new way of making movies changed Hollywood forever.
articles.zh: 漫威电影宇宙始于2008年的《钢铁侠》，这部电影开启了一个新时代，展示了超级英雄电影可以既刺激又有趣。
points: began with... started everything 开创了新时代
rich inventor 富有的发明家
connected to others 相互连接
changed Hollywood forever 永远改变了好莱坞

articles.title: Avengers Assemble
articles.content: The Avengers movie brought together many heroes for the first time. Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, and Hulk all worked together. This was a dream come true for comic fans. The movie showed heroes from different worlds teaming up. They had to learn to work together despite their differences. The action scenes were amazing. The movie made over a billion dollars worldwide. It proved that team-up movies could be huge successes.
articles.zh: 《复仇者联盟》首次将多位英雄聚集在一起，展示了不同世界的团队合作。
points: brought together many heroes 将多位英雄聚集
dream come true 梦想成真

articles.title: Superhero Powers
articles.content: Superheroes have amazing powers. Iron Man has a high-tech suit. Captain America has super strength and a shield. Thor can control lightning. Hulk becomes very strong when angry. Spider-Man can climb walls and shoot webs. These powers make them special. But what makes them heroes is not just powers. It's their courage to help others. They use their gifts to protect people and fight for justice.
articles.zh: 超级英雄拥有非凡的能力，但使他们成为英雄的不仅仅是能力，还有帮助他人的勇气。
points: courage to help others 帮助他人的勇气
fight for justice 为正义而战

articles.title: Movie Villains
articles.content: Every superhero needs a good villain. Villains in superhero movies are often complex. They have reasons for what they do. Loki wants power but also feels lonely. Thanos wants to save the universe in his own way. These villains are not just evil. They have depth and backstories. This makes them interesting and scary at the same time. Good villains make superhero stories more exciting and meaningful.
articles.zh: 超级英雄电影中的反派往往很复杂，他们有动机和背景故事，这使得他们既可怕又有趣。
points: have reasons for what they do 做事有原因
depth and backstories 深度和背景故事
more exciting and更有趣和有意义

articles.title: Special Effects Magic
articles.content: Modern superhero movies use amazing special effects. Computers create impossible worlds. Heroes fly through cities. Battles look real. These effects make the stories believable. They help audiences feel like they are part of the action. The technology keeps getting better. Each new movie pushes the boundaries of what's possible. This makes watching superhero movies an incredible experience.
articles.zh: 现代超级英雄电影使用令人惊叹的特效，创造不可能的世界，让观众感觉身临其境。
points: impossible worlds 不可能的世界
push the boundaries 推开界限
incredible experience 难以置信的体验

articles.title: Fan Culture
articles.content: Superhero movies create strong fan communities. Fans discuss theories online. They cosplay as their favorite heroes. They wait in line for midnight screenings. Fan art and fan fiction are popular. This community makes being a fan more fun. Fans feel connected to each other through their love for these stories. The movies become more than entertainment. They become a shared cultural experience.
articles.zh: 超级英雄电影创造了强大的粉丝社区，粉丝通过理论讨论、cosplay等方式相互连接。
points: shared cultural experience 共享的文化体验

articles.title: Movie Merchandise
articles.content: Superhero movies make money from more than just tickets. Toys, clothes, and other products are very popular. Kids want Iron Man toys. Adults collect superhero figures. These products keep the movie experience alive after watching. They let fans show their love for their favorite heroes. The merchandise business is huge. It brings in billions of dollars every year. This shows how big the superhero movie industry has become.
articles.zh: 超级英雄电影通过玩具、服装等周边产品获得额外收入，让粉丝能够表达对英雄的喜爱。
points: bring in billions 赚取数十亿美元

articles.title: Heroes' Personal Lives
articles.content: Superheroes have normal lives too. Peter Parker goes to school and has friends. Tony Stark runs a company. They struggle with everyday problems. This makes them relatable. We see ourselves in their struggles. They balance hero duties with personal life. This balance makes the characters more real. It shows that even heroes face challenges like normal people.
articles.zh: 超级英雄也有正常的生活，他们面临日常挑战，这让角色更加真实和可亲近。

articles.title: Global Impact
articles.content: Superhero movies are popular worldwide. People from different countries enjoy these stories. The movies are translated into many languages. They bring people together across cultures. Superheroes become global icons. Their stories teach universal values like courage and hope. This global success shows how powerful good storytelling can be. It connects people from all over the world.
articles.zh: 超级英雄电影在全球都很受欢迎，成为跨越文化的全球偶像，传递勇气和希望等普世价值。
points: translated into many languages 翻译成多种语言

articles.title: Future of Superheroes
articles.content: Superhero movies will continue to evolve. New heroes will emerge. Stories will become more diverse. Technology will create even better experiences. Movies might become interactive. Viewers might choose what happens next. The future holds endless possibilities. But one thing is sure: people will always love stories about heroes who inspire us. These stories remind us that we can all be heroes in our own way.
articles.zh: 超级英雄电影将继续发展，新英雄出现，故事更多样化，技术创造更好的体验，未来充满无限可能。
points: continue to evolve 继续发展
